map.算法（太沙基条形基础，整体剪切）：承载力系数 Nq=exp(π·tanφ)·ta: Algorithm (Terzaghi strip footing, overall shear): bearing capacity factor Nq=exp(π·tanφ)·tan²(π/4+φ/2), Nc=(Nq−1)/tanφ (take 5.14 when φ=0), Nγ=2(Nq+1)·…

map.对临时工程可降、对敏感建筑应提高；fa 仅为基础底面承载力，还需验算沉降与软弱下: It can be lowered for temporary works and raised for sensitive buildings; fa is only the base bearing capacity, so settlement and weak underlying layers must also be checked — do not size the slab on fa alone
map.太沙基公式适用于什么条件？: What conditions does the Terzaghi formula apply to?
map.适用于条形基础、地基发生整体剪切破坏、基础埋深不大且水下用有效重度。圆形/方形基: Applies to strip foundations where the ground fails by overall shear, the embedment is shallow, and submerged unit weight is used. Circular or square footings, deep foundations or weak underlying layers require the corresponding correction factors or another formula (e.g. Hansen, Vesic); results from this tool are for reference only.
